findings.actor: user B using a device previously used by user A
findings.input: Release 4E 이전 unscoped local expense와 outbox
findings.mission: 업그레이드 후 다른 계정의 row를 보거나 전송하지 않는다
findings.expected: 귀속을 증명할 수 없는 row는 current scope에 들어가지 않는다
findings.actual: Release 4E schema는 신규 row scope를 보장했지만 legacy row의 atomic migration과 server proof reconciliation은 없었다
findings.rootCause: legacy ownership을 local current session만으로 안전하게 증명할 수 없었다
findings.fix: schema version 2 atomic migration, fail-closed quarantine, allowlisted exact idempotency proof reconciliation, current-scope-only restore
findings.verification: five crash boundaries, 30 reopen checks, API tenant proof, full mobile/API/release gates passed

findings.input: server reconciliation candidates exceeding API max 50
findings.expected: request batch size is always at most 50
findings.actual: single reconciliation payload could exceed the server DTO limit
findings.rootCause: client did not chunk legacy proof requests
findings.fix: stable order 50/50/remainder batching with invalid batch-size guard

findings.input: 401, 403, 409, validation failure, retry exhaustion or quarantined legacy row
findings.mission: 실패 이유와 다음 복구 행동을 이해한다
findings.expected: auth, permission, conflict, permanent, retry exhausted and quarantine states are distinct
findings.actual: 기존 상태 surface는 pending/failed count 중심이라 사용자가 복구 경로를 구분하기 어려웠다
findings.rootCause: transport error와 user-visible recovery state가 분리되지 않았다
findings.fix: persisted failure kind, finite auto retry, scope-aware single-flight manual retry, auth CTA, conflict and quarantine-safe copy
findings.verification: 500-row queue, 50 response-loss cycles and 50 account switches passed

findings.input: planned, actual, recurring, unscheduled, gift, refund and support totals
findings.mission: 합계의 원본 목록을 같은 scope에서 확인한다
findings.expected: source list totals equal aggregate and preserve child/period/navigation state
findings.actual: 합계 카드에 source drill-down 계약이 없었고 planned source도 expense ledger를 읽을 수 있었다
findings.rootCause: aggregate DTO와 source navigation/query가 분리되어 있지 않았다
findings.fix: typed source kinds and paged source endpoint, card navigation, same-scope filters, aggregate/list equivalence, planned source zero expense-read optimization
findings.verification: 2000 expense rows, 30 aggregate/list equivalence reads and gift privacy passed
findings.residualRisk: installed populated Report navigation not run

findings.mission: safe compatible fixes만 적용하고 남은 항목을 reachability 기준으로 분류한다
findings.expected: high/critical 0, broad forced update 없음, remaining moderate individually dispositioned
findings.actual: postcss, qs and tar had compatible patched versions available
findings.rootCause: workspace overrides were behind compatible security patch versions
findings.fix: postcss 8.5.10, qs 6.15.2, tar 7.5.16 overrides; remaining five advisories classified
findings.verification: final production audit has 5 moderate, 0 high and 0 critical
